moments.action: On a floodlit rooftop cage pitch a man in a red beanie barges through a tackle and leaves an opponent sprawled on the turf; play stops and he ends squared up nose to nose, shouting at the man in the purple sweater.

Cut to a pedestrian bridge high over the neon crossing: a long-haired man in an olive jacket talks and swigs a drink, then a reverse angle reveals a short-haired man beside him, both now looking down at the lit street.

Tight profiles alternate above the glowing street: the long-haired man speaks, the short-haired man listens and answers, and the exchange tightens until the long-haired man lowers his gaze and goes quiet.
A long held close-up sits on the short-haired man, eyes lowered and half-smiling; the other man also stares down, then the short-haired man's head comes up sharply, eyes wide and the smile gone.

The long-haired man takes over the talking while the short-haired man stares back hard; twice the film cuts away to the crowd flooding the crossing far below, returning each time tighter on the speaker's face.
Both men fall quiet: the short-haired man's eyes drop shut, the long-haired man looks down past the rail, then the short-haired man lifts his head again with a set, hardened stare off into the neon.

The camera pulls back low and wide, leaving the pair small on the walkway under a red neon sign as one tips his drink back, then lifts away to an aerial of the glowing rooftop pitch beside the packed street.
